description: Server SDK request shape, response handling and error mapping (M11; protocol v1 section 22). A case is { name, call, args, response, expected }. call is verify, createAssessment, annotate, eraseAccount or cardFields. args are wire-neutral camelCase: verify { token, options }, createAssessment { input }, annotate { aid, input? }, eraseAccount { input }, cardFields { bin?, last4? }; timeoutMs (an integer of milliseconds, applied at construction) is optional on any HTTP call. response (null for cardFields) is { status, headers, body | bodyBase64 | bodyRepeat: { chunk, times }, delayMs?, hangup?: "before-headers" | "mid-body" }: a string body is sent as it is, any other body is JSON-encoded, bodyBase64 is the raw bytes, bodyRepeat is chunk repeated times times, delayMs is how long the server waits before answering, and hangup closes the connection before the headers, or after the first part of the body. expected.request is null when nothing is sent, else { method, path (slug-free, from /v1), contentType, auth, form?, json?, jsonSubset? }: auth bearer means Authorization: Bearer <the fixture secret> and no secret anywhere else, form-secret means a secret form field holding the fixture secret and no Authorization header; the secret is never in the URL. form is the other form fields, compared as a set of fields (no field twice); json is compared as a value, never as bytes; jsonSubset must be contained in the sent JSON. Exactly one of outcome { ok, reason? } (verify), error { code, status, requestId?, retryAfterSeconds?, unavailable? } (an absent requestId or retryAfterSeconds must be absent; unavailable is true exactly for the 503 subclass), inputError true (the language argument error, with no request) or result (a projection: every field named here must equal the field of the parsed answer; null for a call that returns nothing). Every expectation is proven against the Node SDK (sdks/node/test/sdk-http.test.ts). score-invalid cannot come out of verify over HTTP, because the response reader turns an invalid score into not-verified; relying-party.json covers it. Regenerate with `pnpm --filter @revokegpt/protocol vectors:sdk-http`.
